best_idea: Record one ring of snapshot samples per target on each broadcast, and let every shooter read the targets at its own render time, clamped into one short window and falling back to live when the stamp is missing, so the hit test judges what the shooter saw.
decision_why: It gives the server-verified kill rule a fair hit test (what the shooter saw) with one history per target shared by up to MAX_ATTACKERS = 3 shooters; adapt because the donor's window is a fairness dial we must set, its clamp uses the wrong window for per-attach rings, and its delta-coded stamps need reliable in-order delivery we must not assume.
acceptance: A server test: a target moves from x=100 to x=120 between two broadcasts 100 ms apart, a shot stamped at the earlier render time hits at x=100 and is recorded as a hit, a shot stamped 800 ms back is clamped to the 500 ms window edge and is flagged clamped, and a shot with stamp 0 is judged on live positions; in play a shot that looks like a hit on the shooter's phone at 150 ms ping registers as a hit on the server.
